name: Touch of Moonlight shows its Lunar Eclipse line once Lunar Eclipse is known (#7950)
contract: Touch of Moonlight 574328 is a Lunar Phase spell (AscensionStarcaller.cpp Lunar()
lists it), so casting it under Lunar Eclipse 800386 refunds its mana cost and
grants a Lunar Phase stack (AscensionStarcallerAbilities.cpp, id == 574328 branch).
The client's Spell.dbc description already contains that Lunar Eclipse paragraph,
but gates it on $?s524781 (knowing the Lunar Phase passive), which Starcaller code
never teaches as a spell: Refresh() only applies 524781 as an aura to holders of
800386. The clause therefore never renders even while Eclipse works, which is the
#7950 report. The fix publishes 574328 in coa_client_spell_description with the
clause re-gated on $?s800386, mirroring Huntress Shot's $?s92134 gate, and streams
it via SMSG_PATCH_SPELL (opcode 2346). This scenario reads the streamed rows and
then proves the text is true: 574328 must arrive with the Lunar line, the
Soulrend row keeps its own line as the stream control, and an Eclipsed Touch
consumes the Eclipse, refunds its mana and leaves one Lunar Phase stack.
